context:
Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan task P1.2 (CRIT-1b(i), A1.7). Evidence: same chDB run had 3 corroborated catalog facts (orders/lineitem sort_key, lineitem partition_key toyyyymm(l_shipdate)) vetoed by 2 spurious drops.

Delivered by PR #2636 (squash-merged 2026-10-04, merge SHA 0b257b24032cf06a8f1bddd081ca94dd95e1606d), implementing ADR-001 addendum "ledger outcome and phase vocabulary" (b) (PR #2634).

What shipped: the applied ledger has a non-blocking `satisfied` outcome {intent, satisfied_by, reason}; satisfied_by is the index of the executed statement in ledger.statements. It serializes in its own `satisfied` list next to `dropped` (only when non-empty), is outside the applied_ledger_hash, never touches corroborate()'s verifiable set, is redacted (count-preserving) in anonymized exports, counts toward the bundle per-array limit (validation/bundle.py), and is not pruned as an empty ledger (results/schema.py). SortedIngestionMixin records it when the capability registry marks sorting rendered_via="ddl" (ClickHouse local/server/cloud, StarRocks, Doris; registry already said ddl, unchanged) and an executed DDL-phase CREATE TABLE for that table has an ORDER BY containing the requested columns in order (ORDER BY tuple() or other columns do not satisfy it; a sort with no matching recorded DDL is still a drop). A platform that renders sorting neither via DDL nor CTAS still records a drop; with sorted ingestion off the reason is "sorted_ingestion_mode=off" (Athena, Synapse, Snowflake, Databricks previously said "does not support CTAS sort"). Not done, by design: no Explorer rendering of `satisfied` (the main workstream owns those files), and no docs/reference/result-formats.md entry yet because the bundle-shape change to that page had not merged (PRs #2628/#2629 were open) — add the payload field there after it lands.

Verification (acceptance):
- Unit: tests/unit/platforms/test_sort_realized_by_ddl.py (16 tests): ClickHouse local/server/cloud and StarRocks sort with registry ddl -> no dropped intent; platform with neither -> dropped; mode off -> reason sorted_ingestion_mode=off for snowflake/athena/azure-synapse/databricks; satisfied never changes corroboration. 12 of the 16 fail on the previous code.
- e2e (clickhouse-local, custom config tests/fixtures/tuning/clickhouse_sort_partition.yaml: LINEITEM sort (L_ORDERKEY, L_LINENUMBER) + partition L_SHIPDATE, ORDERS sort (O_ORDERKEY, O_ORDERDATE), constraints disabled): BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=<scratch> PYTHONPATH=<chdb 3.6.0 target> uv run -- benchbox run --platform clickhouse-local --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --tuning tests/fixtures/tuning/clickhouse_sort_partition.yaml --phases generate,load,power --queries 1 --non-interactive -> exit 0; platform.tuning: validation_status applied_verified, dropped [], 2 satisfied entries (redacted in the exported local file), receipt corroborated 3 of 3 (2 sort_key, 1 partition_key), zero failed statements. chDB 3.6.0 was used because the pinned chDB 4.1.6 does not load on macOS 27 (dlopen LINKEDIT error); a metadata-save timestamp error in that older engine was non-fatal and unrelated.
- pytest -m fast: 33900 passed. Independent subagent review, final head: no Critical/Required findings; one Consider (the satisfied match accepts the requested columns anywhere in a contiguous run, matching the generator's cluster-then-sort ORDER BY).

description:
## Problem (reproduced on chDB)
ClickHouse (local, server, cloud) and StarRocks pass `tuning_config` to `DataLoader` (`clickhouse/workload.py:709-715`, `starrocks/workload.py:475-481`). After each load, the shared `SortedIngestionMixin.apply_ctas_sort` calls `_build_ctas_sort_sql`, gets `None` (default at `sorted_ingestion.py:429`), and records the dropped intent `sorted_ingestion <t> ORDER BY …` / "ClickHouse Local does not support CTAS sort" (`sorted_ingestion.py:144-152`). The sort was already realized by `ORDER BY` DDL and corroborated in the catalog, but any dropped intent vetoes `applied_verified`. ClickHouse can never verify.

Also, with the opt-in `sorted_ingestion_mode` off, Athena, Synapse, Snowflake and Databricks report the misleading reason "does not support CTAS sort".

## Change
- Make the capability registry state sorting `rendered_via="ddl"` for ClickHouse and StarRocks.
- When `_build_ctas_sort_sql` returns `None` and the registry says sorting renders via DDL, record nothing, or the D-6 non-blocking `satisfied_by`.
- When the mode is off, the reason is `sorted_ingestion_mode=off`.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A sort requested on a platform that neither renders it via DDL nor CTAS still records a drop.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
